verses.2:276: يَمۡحَقُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّبَوٰاْ وَيُرۡبِي ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.3:141: وَلِيُمَحِّصَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَيَمۡحَقَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

meaning: The root مَحَقَ (maḥaqa) means to diminish, deprive of blessing, or completely obliterate something, leaving no trace. It implies a total doing away with.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
